I. Foreign trade turnover 
In January-August 2026, Uzbekistan's foreign trade turnover (FTT) amounted to USD 57,4 
billion, increasing by USD 4,0 billion, or 7,6%, compared with the corresponding period of 2025.  
 
 
 
Foreign trade turnover*, January-August, USD million 
 
 
Within total FTT, exports amounted to USD 22,9 billion (down 3,4% from January -
August 2025), while imports reached USD 34,5 billion (up 16,3% from January -August 2025). 
Consequently, a trade deficit of USD 11,7 billion was recorded. 
At the same time, excluding gold, merchandise exports increased by 28,7% year on year 
to USD 11,5 billion. 
 
 
* All figures for previous years presented in this press release have been recalculated using annual customs and statistical data.
